events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV impact
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV changed music forever. Remember the moment 'Video Killed The Radio Star' ushered in a new era?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' still sounds as fresh today as it did when it dropped back in '94. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, a field in New York became the epicentre of a generation. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King of Rock and Roll. His music and legend continue to inspire millions.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot on September 7, 1996, and tragically died six days later on September 13, 1996, in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a true icon. Tupac's influence on hip-hop and beyond remains immense.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost an unparalleled talent. Jimi Hendrix's innovation continues to shape guitar music.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Still one of the greatest albums of all time. What's your top track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Bday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher's Bday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic song 'Imagine' as a single on October 11, 1971, in the US and October 24, 1971, in the UK. The album 'Imagine' was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' gave us a timeless message of peace and hope. Still resonates today.

events.title: iPod's 25th anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod impact
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod and changed how we listen to music forever. Who remembers their first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond celebration
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and over sixty years of iconic cinema.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese's Bday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their double album 'The Beatles', commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that still sparks debate.
